chapter: Teenage bands and Florida road tours
title: Ten men in one 16-cylinder Cadillac
summary: The band toured when he was fourteen, packing ten players and their instruments into one Cadillac.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: But we went on the road with this band when I was 14 years old, and a lot of people, they don't remember this, but there was a 16-cylinder Cadillac at one time with the running board on the side, and the two jump seats in the middle, so we carried 9 men in this one Cadillac -- no, ten! All in this one Cadillac; we had 10 men and in this one Cadillac. We had three in front, including the driver, we had three on the jump seat and then four on the back seat. We were very close, just like sardines.
And this car used to run -- like every 60 miles we had to put oil in it.
That's what you'd call a close knit band.

Yeah. And then the bass drum and the bass violin rode on the top, and the trap rode on the running board, on the side of the running board, we had it enclosed where you could put the instruments and the suitcases and everything, and the ones who couldn't go on the outside, we held them in our laps -- and that's how we traveled.
Boy, what a picture. That's too much.
